ray_relative_contact.statement: theorem ray_relative_contact : ∃ x ∈ intrinsicInterior ℝ (effectiveDomain Tests.OnlineConvexMinorant.loss), ∃ (a : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ), ((a x + b : ℝ) : EReal) = Tests.OnlineConvexMinorant.loss x ∧ ∀ y, ((a y + b : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ Tests.OnlineConvexMinorant.loss y

singleton_boundary.statement: theorem singleton_boundary : extendedIndicator ({1} : Set ℝ) 1 = 0 ∧ extendedIndicator ({1} : Set ℝ) 0 = ⊤ ∧ interior (effectiveDomain (extendedIndicator ({1} : Set ℝ))) = ∅
